ideas.pitch: An AI-guided visual programming assistant tailored for school students to rapidly convert conceptual logic flowcharts into working interactive web applications.
ideas.title: VibeCode Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'Vibecoding' stage of the Olympiad where students must use AI and code to turn ideas into reality, impressing judges with accessibility and rapid execution.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic quiz generation and personalized study path creator that converts school textbook chapters into interactive gamified knowledge assessments.
ideas.title: ConceptQuest AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven hackathon-winning architecture (QuizGenAI) that targets student education, directly appealing to organizers like Navneet Education who focus on school learning.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered career mentor and roadmap generator designed specifically for Indian high school students navigating higher education streams and entrance exams.
ideas.title: FutureTrack India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of localized career guidance platforms (FutureYou) combined with high utility for the target demographic of Classes 8 to 12 students.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document platform that turns dense NCERT syllabus PDFs into interactive mind-maps and chat-enabled knowledge bases for younger learners.
ideas.title: DocuSynapse Junior
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven Adobe Hackathon runner-up concept into a simplified, highly polished tool for school curriculum revision.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser-based medical and biological science concept simulator that lets students test physiological experiments safely using AI-driven feedback.
ideas.title: BioSimulate AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the creativity and problem-solving criteria of the Olympiad by bringing complex STEM subjects to life through interactive AI simulation.
